CURSOR.summary: Returns the write cursor of the active segment of a volume.

reply_schema.description: The write cursor of the active segment.

active_segment_id.description: Id of the segment that receives new writes.

versionstamp.description: Base32-hex encoded Versionstamp of the last write, or an empty string if the volume has no data.

next_position.description: Byte offset of the next write in the active segment.

sequence_number.description: Changelog sequence number of the last mutation. -1 if the volume is empty or the entry was pruned.

arguments.name: volume-name
arguments.summary: The name of the volume, in the format <kind>-shard-<id>.
